items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I told you! to Hop, you know, I told you! You never heard of Sandtop. No.

ctx.x: sure glad to see Babe in town. I said, I am, too, Hop. And, Hop's not a drinking man. Hop said, Come on, let's have a taste. I want to introduce you to a cat. ... so we go over to this cat's place right in the neighborhood. Now, dig this idea. I'm a baseball fan. I played baseball. Hop played baseball. I could possibly have gotten into the major leagues. He thinks he could have gotten into the major leagues, too. So, ... OK. So he says to me, he says, he gets over to this place. Now, Chester Street at that time…
so he couldn't get me or any other
